claims.assertion: Anéeka describes the Moon as an Andromedan biosphere ship named Creirddylad, built in nested layers with life-support and engineering systems around a central reactor.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says apparent surface structures are part of the ship's hull.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says the Federation maintains the Moon's artificial orbit, with control passing among Centauri, Taygeta, and current Arcturian-Dieslientiplex operators.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says the orbit requires periodic correction.
